enabled.description: Enable or disable the MOM daemon (restart required after change).

state_file.description: Path to MOM runtime state file for persistence between restarts.

policy_directory.description: Directory containing additional per-policy configuration files.

poll_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between resource evaluations and policy enforcement checks.

memory_enabled.description: Enable dynamic memory overcommitment and ballooning.

memory_max_overcommit_ratio.description: Maximum memory overcommitment ratio (guest total memory / host physical memory).

min_free_memory.description: Minimum free memory (MiB) to retain on host to prevent OOM conditions.

balancer_threshold.description: Memory pressure threshold (MiB) above which aggressive memory balancing is triggered.

ballooning_enabled.description: Allow dynamic memory balloon drivers to be used for guest memory reclamation.

cpu_enabled.description: Enable dynamic CPU overcommitment and throttling.

cpu_max_overcommit_ratio.description: Maximum CPU overcommitment ratio (total vCPUs allocated / physical CPU cores).

min_shares_per_vm.description: Minimum CPU shares guaranteed per VM (CFS scheduler weight, range 0–1024).

cpu_throttling_policy.description: Throttling strategy: none (no throttling), constant (fixed shares), adaptive (reactive based on load).

disk_enabled.description: Enable disk I/O throttling per VM and globally.

max_total_iops.description: Maximum total I/O operations per second allowed across all VMs.

max_per_vm_iops.description: Maximum I/O operations per second allowed per VM.

burst_allowed_percent.description: Allowed burst above max limits (as a percentage).

network_enabled.description: Enable network bandwidth QoS per VM and globally.

max_total_bandwidth.description: Maximum total bandwidth (Mbps) allowed across all VMs.

network_burst_allowed_percent.description: Allowed network bandwidth burst above limit (as percentage).

memory_pressure_cmd.description: Command template executed when memory pressure occurs. Supports placeholders: {vm} (VM name), {action} (balloon/balance), {reason}.

cpu_throttling_cmd.description: Command template executed when CPU throttling is triggered. Supports placeholders: {vm}, {action}, {reason}.

policy_engine_interval.description: The wake up frequency of the policy engine (in seconds).

controllers.description: A comma-separated list of Controller plugins to enable.

libvirt_hypervisor_uri.description: The URI to use when connecting to this host's libvirt interface.

plot_dir.description: Directory to enable plotting (empty string disables).

policy_file.description: At startup, load a policy from this file. If empty, no policy is loaded.
